belgium.title: Malicious File in Downloads Folder Tries to Trick AI Coding Agent Into Installing Malware
belgium.summary: A malicious instruction file sitting in a developer's Downloads folder tried to make their AI coding agent install a known-malicious npm package, security firm Forever Security said in a report published last week. The company caught the attempt on a real customer's machine and stopped the agent before any code ran.
